required.quote: The Department may adopt rules of continuing education for persons licensed under this Act.

available.quote: The Department may, upon application in writing on forms or electronically accompanied by the required fee, issue a license as a perfusionist to an applicant who is a perfusionist licensed under the law of another state, the District of Columbia, territory, or country, if the requirements for licensure in that jurisdiction were, at the date of original licensure, substantially equivalent to the requirements in force in this State.

requirements.value: Requirements for licensure in the other jurisdiction must have been substantially equivalent to Illinois requirements at the date of original licensure. ABCP-certified clinical perfusionists (prior to January 1, 1999) may also apply by endorsement.
requirements.quote: if the requirements for licensure in that jurisdiction were, at the date of original licensure, substantially equivalent to the requirements in force in this State.

title_protection.quote: No person may use the title and designation of a "Licensed Perfusionist", "Certified Perfusionist", "Certified Clinical Perfusionist", "Perfusionist", or "CCP", either directly or indirectly, in connection with his or her profession or business, unless he or she has been issued a valid, existing license as a perfusionist under this Act.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Making a material misstatement in furnishing information to the Department.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Making a material misstatement in furnishing information to the Department.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Negligence, incompetence, or misconduct in the practice of perfusion.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Negligence, incompetence, or misconduct in the practice of perfusion.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to comply with any provisions of this Act or any of its rules.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure to comply with any provisions of this Act or any of its rules.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Fraud or misrepresentation in applying for or procuring a license under this Act.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Fraud or any misrepresentation in applying for or procuring a license under this Act or in connection with applying for renewal or restoration of a license under this Act.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Purposefully making false statements or signing false statements, certificates, or affidavits to induce payment.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Purposefully making false statements or signing false statements, certificates, or affidavits to induce payment.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conviction of or entry of a plea of guilty or nolo contendere to a felony or certain misdemeanors directly related to the practice of perfusion.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Conviction of or entry of a plea of guilty or nolo contendere, finding of guilt, jury verdict, or entry of judgment or sentencing, including, but not limited to, convictions, preceding sentences of supervision, conditional discharge, or first offender probation under the laws of any jurisdiction of the United States that is (i) a felony or (ii) a misdemeanor, an essential element of which is dishonesty, that is directly related to the practice of the profession of perfusion.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Aiding or assisting another in violating any provision of this Act or its rules.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Aiding or assisting another in violating any provision of this Act or its rules.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to provide information in response to a written request made by the Department within 60 days.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing to provide information in response to a written request made by the Department within 60 days after receipt of such written request.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaging in dishonorable, unethical, or unprofessional conduct of a character likely to deceive, defraud, or harm the public.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Engaging in dishonorable, unethical, or unprofessional conduct of a character likely to deceive, defraud, or harm the public as defined by rule.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Habitual or excessive use or abuse of controlled substances, alcohol, or other substances resulting in inability to practice safely.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Habitual or excessive use or abuse of drugs defined in law as controlled substances, of alcohol, narcotics, stimulants, or any other substances that results in the inability to practice with reasonable judgment, skill, or safety.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to pay a fine imposed by the Department.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: A finding by the Department that an applicant or licensee has failed to pay a fine imposed by the Department.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violation of the terms of probation after license placed on probationary status.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: A finding by the Department that the licensee, after having his or her license placed on probationary status, has violated the terms of probation, or failed to comply with such terms.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Inability to practice the profession with reasonable judgment, skill, or safety as a result of physical or mental illness or disability.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Inability to practice the profession with reasonable judgment, skill, or safety as a result of physical illness, including, but not limited to, deterioration through the aging process, loss of motor skill, mental illness, or disability.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Discipline by another state, territory, foreign country, or government agency for grounds substantially equivalent to those in this Act.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Discipline by another state, territory, foreign country, the District of Columbia, the United States government, or any other government agency if at least one of the grounds for discipline is the same or substantially equivalent to those set forth in this Act.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Making a willfully false oath or affirmation in any matter where an oath is required by this Act.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The making of any willfully false oath or affirmation in any matter or proceeding where an oath or affirmation is required by this Act.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Using or attempting to use an expired, inactive, suspended, or revoked license, or impersonating another licensee.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Using or attempting to use an expired, inactive, suspended, or revoked license, or the certificate or seal of another, or impersonating another licensee.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Directly or indirectly giving or receiving any fee, commission, rebate, or other compensation for professional services not actually rendered.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Directly or indirectly giving to or receiving from any person or entity any fee, commission, rebate, or other form of compensation for any professional service not actually or personally rendered.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Willfully making or filing false records or reports related to the licensee's practice.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Willfully making or filing false records or reports related to the licensee's practice, including, but not limited to, false records filed with federal or State agencies or departments.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Willfully failing to report an instance of suspected child abuse or neglect.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Willfully failing to report an instance of suspected child abuse or neglect as required under the Abused and Neglected Child Reporting Act.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Being named as a perpetrator in an indicated report of child abuse or neglect by DCFS.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Being named as a perpetrator in an indicated report by the Department of Children and Family Services under the Abused and Neglected Child Reporting Act and upon proof, by clear and convincing evidence, that the licensee has caused a child to be an abused child or neglected child

disciplinary_grounds.description: Immoral conduct in the commission of an act related to the licensee's practice, including sexual abuse or misconduct.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Immoral conduct in the commission of an act related to the licensee's practice, including but not limited to sexual abuse, sexual misconduct, or sexual exploitation.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violation of the Health Care Worker Self-Referral Act.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violation of the Health Care Worker Self-Referral Act.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Solicitation of business or professional services, other than permitted advertising.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Solicitation of business or professional services, other than permitted advertising.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conviction of or cash compromise of a charge or violation of the Illinois Controlled Substances Act.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Conviction of or cash compromise of a charge or violation of the Illinois Controlled Substances Act.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Gross, willful, or continued overcharging for professional services, including filing false statements for collection of fees for services not rendered.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Gross, willful, or continued overcharging for professional services, including filing false statements for collection of fees for which services are not rendered.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Practicing under a false or assumed name.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Practicing under a false name or, except as allowed by law, an assumed name.

definition_quote.value: "Perfusion" means the functions necessary for the support, treatment, measurement, or supplementation of the cardiovascular systems or other organs, or a combination of those functions, and to ensure the safe management of physiologic functions by monitoring and analyzing the parameters of the systems under an order and under the supervision of a physician licensed to practice medicine in all its branches.
definition_quote.quote: "Perfusion" means the functions necessary for the support, treatment, measurement, or supplementation of the cardiovascular systems or other organs, or a combination of those functions, and to ensure the safe management of physiologic functions by monitoring and analyzing the parameters of the systems under an order and under the supervision of a physician licensed to practice medicine in all its branches.

methods_authorized.quote: The scope of practice as a clinical perfusionist includes the following functions: (1) the use of extracorporeal circulation, long-term cardiopulmonary support techniques, including extracorporeal carbon dioxide removal and extracorporeal membrane oxygenation, and associated therapeutic and diagnostic techniques; (2) counterpulsation, ventricular assistance, autotransfusion, blood conservation techniques, myocardial and organ preservation, extracorporeal life support, and isolated limb perfusion; (3) blood management techniques, advanced life support, and other related functions
